description: Obtaining a Grant from the Asia Pacific Disaster Response Fund for  Post-Disaster Relief and Rehabilitation Work
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2025-12-10 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - The Asian Development Bank has established the Asia Pacific Disaster Response Fund on 2009-04-01 to provide incremental grant for developing member countries to restore life-preserving services immediately after disasters triggered by natural hazards, including disease outbreaks. The Government of Sri Lanka has requested the Asian Development Bank to provide funds required for the emergency response project implemented relating to the disaster caused by Cyclone Ditwah. Accordingly, the Asian Development Bank has agreed to provide a Grant of US$ 3 million under the Asia Pacific Disaster Response Fund. It is expected to supply items necessary to provide life-preserving services to the affected communities through the said Grant. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Hon. President, in his capacity as the Minister of Finance, Planning and Economic Development, to enter into the relevant Agreements with the Asian Development Bank to obtain the said Grant, was approved by the Cabinet.
